origin.description: Create an OSC 8 terminal hyperlink, when the terminal claims to support one.

arguments.name: url
arguments.text: URL to open. text and url are recycled when links are enabled.

origin.details: When has_hyperlink() is FALSE the text is returned unchanged. Otherwise the text is wrapped in the OSC 8 open and close sequences.
origin.value: The text, or the text wrapped as a hyperlink.
origin.example:
options(crayon.hyperlink = TRUE)
cat("This is an", hyperlink("R", "https://r-project.org"), "link.\n")

translation.description: Create an OSC 8 terminal hyperlink, when the terminal claims to support one.
translation.details: A false has_hyperlink() returns the text and does not recycle it against the URL. A true result pastes the OSC 8 wrapper, recycling a length-1 side.
translation.value: The text, or the wrapped link.
translation.example:
options(**{"crayon.hyperlink": True})
print("This is an", hyperlink("R", "https://r-project.org"), "link.")
